description: Located in a highly desirable neighborhood, this spacious home is the perfect blank canvas for your design vision! Boasting a highly functional floor plan, generous living spaces, and excellent structural bones, this property is a fantastic opportunity to build instant sweat equity. Bring your favorite paint swatches and flooring ideas to transform this cosmetic fixer into a neighborhood showstopper. Whether you are looking to customize your dream space or searching for a high-upside project, this property offers incredible value. Community pool and spa for entertaining or a hot summer swim. Located close to Hwy 80, I-5, The Sacramento Airport, Garden Hwy, the Sacramento and American River, and minutes to downtown.
